class.name: JarBodyWater
class.brief_description: Water at the body's sea level.
class.description: A sphere on round bodies, a plane on flat ones: a coarse mesh for distant water plus a dense patch that follows the camera; the shader projects both onto the exact sea level, so coasts are precise up close. Fogs the view under water. The default materials ([code]water.gdshader[/code], [code]underwater.gdshader[/code]) are created at runtime; assign your own to change the look.

method.name: get_active_material
method.description: The water material in use: [member material] or the default.

members.member: Raises (or lowers) the water above the body's sea level, in meters.
The water's look. Empty: the default [code]water.gdshader[/code].
Quads along each side of the dense patch.
Width of the dense patch around the camera, in meters.
The fog under water. Empty: the default [code]underwater.gdshader[/code].
